attributes.title: To change our existing website into an Ecommerce platform
attributes.proj_desc:
We are looking for an experienced Wix developer to add full e-commerce functionality to our existing Rock Recycling website:

View our current website

We are an aggregates and recycling business based in Andover, Hampshire, expanding our website to allow customers to purchase landscaping and aggregate products online.

This is not a new website build. We want to develop our existing Wix website into a professional e-commerce site while retaining the existing branding and overall structure.

E-Commerce Requirements
Wix e-commerce/store setup
Online product catalogue
Shopping basket and secure checkout/payment
Product variations where required
Correct VAT configuration/display
Inventory/product availability management
Postcode-based delivery pricing
Collection option from our Andover yard
Mobile optimisation
Fast, intuitive customer journey
Analytics/conversion tracking
Appropriate accessibility
Simple back-end management for products, prices and orders
Products

The initial store will contain [X] existing products plus 3 new products.

We will supply product descriptions, images, prices, delivery charges and delivery-zone/postcode information.

Following training, we intend to upload approximately 10 further products ourselves, so the system needs to make adding and managing products straightforward.

Postcode-Based Delivery

This is an important part of the project.

We sell heavy bulk landscaping and aggregate products, so standard parcel shipping is not suitable. We currently intend to operate [X] delivery zones and will supply the relevant postcodes and delivery charges.

Customers should be able to enter their delivery postcode and receive the appropriate delivery charge.

Experience implementing postcode, distance or zonal delivery pricing within Wix would be beneficial.

SEO, Local SEO & AI Search

We want the site optimised for strong organic visibility through both conventional search engines and newer AI-powered search/answer platforms.

Scope should include:

Technical/on-page SEO
Local SEO targeting Andover, Hampshire and our delivery areas
Change the site name currently showing as “My Site” to “Rock Recycling”
Improve homepage SEO title and meta description
Review/tidy existing homepage copy and spelling
Optimise product/category pages
Keyword/search-intent optimisation
Internal linking, crawlability, sitemap and indexing
LocalBusiness and Product structured data/schema
Appropriate delivery-area/location pages
GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)
AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)
Structure content for visibility/discovery through AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Claude
Analytics/search performance tracking

We are not simply looking for an SEO app/plugin to be installed. Applicants should understand modern SEO, Local SEO and GEO/AEO and explain the work they propose to carry out.

Deliverables
Fully operational Wix e-commerce store
Initial products and delivery zones configured
Secure checkout/payment and VAT setup
Collection option
Mobile/desktop optimisation
SEO and Local SEO improvements
Product/category optimisation
LocalBusiness and Product schema where appropriate
Delivery-area pages
GEO/AEO optimisation
Analytics/tracking configuration
Full pre-launch testing
Basic training/documentation
Post-launch support for initial bugs/minor adjustments
When Applying

Please provide:

Examples of Wix e-commerce websites you have developed
Experience with postcode/zonal delivery pricing and how you would implement ours
Examples of SEO/Local SEO work
Details of genuine GEO/AEO or AI-search optimisation experience
What you would implement to improve our visibility through Google and AI-powered search
Your proposed approach
A fixed-price quotation, clearly stating what is and isn't included

We are looking for a professional and reliable developer, rather than simply the lowest-cost proposal.

Budget

£500–£1,500

The budget is indicative and we are open to proposals depending on experience and the solution proposed. We would prefer a fixed total project price rather than an open-ended hourly arrangement.

attributes.title: Creative Illustrator & Designer for Premium Oracle Card Deck
attributes.proj_desc:
I'm looking for a talented, imaginative illustrator and graphic designer to help bring a creative card collection to life.

The initial project involves designing 26 character-based cards, with a further 26 planned for a second phase.

Each card will feature an individual human character or portrait representing a particular personality, emotional state or behavioural pattern, alongside a small amount of structured written content.

All 26 cards will follow the same design and layout. The initial creative work will involve establishing the overall aesthetic, character illustration style, typography and positioning of the text. Once the first design is agreed, it will serve as the template for the remaining cards, with the character expression and written content changing for each one.

I've already created a preliminary design in Canva, so there is an existing concept to work from. However, I'm not a professional designer, and I'm looking for someone with genuine creative flair who can take my idea and turn it into something far more sophisticated.

The finished cards need to feel high-end, elegant, clean and beautifully designed, with a consistent visual identity throughout the collection. I'm looking for something distinctive and professional, rather than cartoonish, overly decorative or generic.

I'm happy for AI to be used to create the character illustrations, provided the finished artwork is carefully refined and doesn't have that obvious AI-generated appearance.

The cards will need to be suitable for professional printing as well as digital use, with editable source files supplied.

I'd love to hear from designers who enjoy creative projects and have a strong eye for detail, typography and visual composition.

When applying, please include:-

Examples of relevant work or a link to your portfolio.

Your estimated price for completing all 26 cards.

Your availability and anticipated turnaround time.

Whether you use AI-assisted illustration.

Further details, including my existing designs and the written content, will be shared privately with suitable applicants.

I'm looking for someone who can bring their own creative ideas to the project and help create a collection that feels genuinely special.

A small request when applying: I'd really like to hear from you personally, in your own words, rather than receive an AI-generated proposal. I'm looking for someone with genuine creativity and individuality, and I'd love to get a feel for the person behind the work. Please don't use AI to write your application, as AI-generated responses won't be considered. I'm much more interested in an authentic, thoughtful message than a perfectly polished pitch.

attributes.title: Short-form video editor, ongoing monthly, for UK salon marketing
attributes.proj_desc:
WHAT THIS IS

I run a UK marketing service for salons and barbershops. We make short
vertical videos for our clients' social media and Google Business profiles.

This is ongoing monthly work, not a one-off project. I am looking for one
editor to work with for the long term.

THE WORK

20 to 30 second vertical videos, 1080x1920, made from photos and clips I
supply. 

36 hour turnaround per video.

RATE

GBP 250 a month, ongoing

WHAT I EXPECT

- If an asset is missing or will not work, you tell me. You never substitute
  something that looks close.
- You have opinions about what makes a short video work, and you can explain
  them.

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You find repetition unbearable. This is 30 or more videos a month, most of
  them variations on templates you built.
- You go quiet when something goes wrong. A late warning is fine. A silent
  missed deadline is not.

WHAT I NEED IN YOUR PROPOSAL

Three things. I read proposals that have all three.

1. Links to two or three vertical short-form videos you made yourself. Not a
   company showreel you were part of.

2. What you edit in, and what your power and internet situation is. Be honest.

3. Send me one short-form video you think is EXCELLENT and one you think is
   POOR, with two sentences on each saying why. They can be anyone's work,
   including your own.

Question 3 is the one I read most carefully. There is no right answer. I want
to know what you notice. Proposals that skip it will not be read, and a generic
template reply tells me nothing about you.

NEXT STEP

Shortlisted candidates get a short paid task: one 20 to 30 second video to a
real brief for a real client. Paid on delivery whatever the outcome, and the
video is yours to keep. Then a 30 minute call where you present it.

I've attached three existing designs that I'm particularly happy with. I'm not looking for a complete redesign, but rather someone who can take these concepts and refine them to a professional standard.

- Subtle adjustments to the HP lettering, shape, proportions and overall appearance.
- Retain the weathered stone/metal effect.
- A professional finish suitable for premium gym apparel.
- Final approved design supplied in editable vector formats (AI, EPS, SVG and PDF), plus transparent PNG.
- Clean, single-colour and textured versions suitable for different clothing printing methods.

The logo will feature on T-shirts, stringer vests, shorts, leggings and other gym apparel.

Potential ongoing work

I'm looking to build a long-term working relationship with a talented designer who understands my vision and can help develop the brand.

If the initial logo project goes well, there will be opportunities for further paid projects.

Budget: £40–£75, depending on experience and portfolio.

Please include examples of previous gym apparel, streetwear or clothing brand design work.

Thank you.

attributes.title: Realistic, Weathered Artwork for Gym Clothing Brand
attributes.proj_desc:
Experienced Graphic Designer Needed – Realistic, Weathered Artwork for Gym Clothing Brand

I'm looking for an experienced graphic designer/illustrator to help develop artwork for my upcoming gym and mental health awareness clothing brand, Honour & Purpose.

I already have several concepts created using AI, which I will provide as references. However, I'm looking for someone who can take these ideas further and produce something more professional, refined and suitable for a premium clothing brand.

The First Project

I've attached two examples:

- Image 1: My original colourful design, featuring a hooded, muscular figure inspired by the Vitruvian Man.
- Image 2: An AI-generated interpretation showing roughly the direction I'd like to take the artwork.

I really like the weathered stone/statue appearance of the second image, particularly the realistic muscular anatomy, cracked textures and black-and-grey colouring.

However, the AI version is far too busy and overcrowded. There's too much happening in the background, and some of the detailing feels excessive.

What I'm Looking For

I'd like a designer who can:

- Redesign and refine the existing concept while maintaining its original identity and symbolism.
- Create realistic, detailed artwork inspired by black-and-grey tattoo designs, classical sculptures and weathered stone.
- Retain the muscular, faceless hooded figure and Vitruvian Man inspiration.
- Simplify the background and remove unnecessary clutter, allowing the main figure to stand out.
- Use predominantly black, grey, charcoal and weathered stone tones.
- Create a powerful, premium-looking graphic suitable for the back of oversized gym T-shirts.
- Incorporate Honour & Purpose branding in a way that complements the artwork rather than overwhelms it.

I'm not looking for cartoon-style illustrations, excessive effects or simply another AI-generated image.

I want someone with a creative eye who can improve the composition, proportions, detailing and overall quality.

Printing Requirements

The final artwork needs to be suitable for professional clothing production, with high-resolution print-ready files, a transparent background where appropriate, and editable source files.

Future Work

This is intended to be the first of several graphic designs.

I have other concepts I'd like to develop, including Atlas-inspired artwork and potentially male and female variations.

Ultimately, I'd like to build a collection of designs that share a consistent visual identity.

There will be opportunities for ongoing paid work with the right designer, although this will be developed gradually rather than being a fast-moving or high-volume project.

Ideal Designer

I'd particularly like to hear from designers experienced in:

- Gym/streetwear clothing graphics
- Realistic illustration and black-and-grey tattoo-style artwork
- Classical sculpture, mythology and distressed textures
- Preparing artwork for professional garment printing

Please share examples of relevant work, particularly realistic clothing graphics or detailed black-and-grey illustrations.

I'm happy to discuss ideas and welcome creative input, provided the original concept and meaning remain intact. 

As this is ongoing work. Affordability will be a key factor. Ideally £50 per edit. 'Per edit' will mean a male and female version. With around 5 edits required.

attributes.title: Make a betting website with a casino
attributes.proj_desc:
I’m ready to launch a full-featured betting platform that combines a traditional sports book with a lively online casino. The site must allow users to place real-time wagers on Football, Basketball and Tennis events, with live odds, in-play betting and a clean statistics feed to keep punters informed.

Alongside the sports book I need an integrated casino lobby featuring Poker, Slots and Roulette. These games have to run smoothly on desktop and mobile, with provably fair or certified RNGs, fast loading times and engaging graphics.

Key pieces I’ll be looking for:

• End-to-end site development: UX/UI design, front-end, back-end, and secure database architecture.  
• Robust account management: registration, KYC flow, wallet, bonuses and responsible-gaming controls.  
• Payments: seamless deposits and withdrawals through major cards, crypto and e-wallets, all handled with industry-standard encryption.  
• Admin dashboard: odds control, game & player management, reporting and risk-monitoring tools.  
• Scalable infrastructure so the platform can handle peak traffic without lag.

I value clean, well-documented code and a developer who can guide me on compliance basics (licensing, geo-blocking, age verification) even if the final paperwork stays on my side. If you’ve launched similar sportsbook-casino hybrids before and can share live links or demos, that will help me shortlist quickly.

Tell me how you’d approach the build, which frameworks or APIs you’d rely on for odds and casino integration, and an estimated timeline from kickoff to launch.

Tools I use:

•	Microsoft Word & Google Docs

Why clients work with me:

•	Double-checked accuracy: I review my work before submitting it because I hate turning in sloppy data. I'd rather take the time to get it 100% right than rush a delivery.
•	No disappearing acts: I manage deadlines proactively. If a task takes longer than expected, I’ll tell you upfront—no silent missing deadlines.
•	Client-focused: I'm currently focused on building a 5-star track record here on PeoplePerHour. I am very flexible and happy to start with a small trial task so you can feel confident in my work.

Whether you need messy spreadsheets formatted, scanned PDFs converted, or web research organized, I am here to make your data error-free and ready to use.
If accuracy and reliability matter to your project, let's talk!
